limitations: Existing test periods have previously been inspected; this is an exploratory comparison, not a new untouched holdout. Threshold calibration and model selection use separate stratified halves of validation. No production replacement or refit.
rule: 50% F1, 25% PR-AUC, 25% ROC-AUC geometric mean minus 0.1 times positive train/selection PR-AUC gap; threshold within 98% of calibration-best F1, prefer balanced precision/recall, calibration FPR <= 5%.
